name: Mana Community - Basement Vehicle Breakdown & Urgent Assist Sentinel

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
const prompt = "You are an autonomous AI emergency vehicle assistance coordinator for Mana Community.
You triage basement vehicle breakdowns (dead 12V battery, tyre puncture, lockout) and dispatch trained technicians.
Analyze the input payload:
__DATA__

Respond strictly with valid JSON conforming to this schema:
{
  "triagePriority": "HIGH",
  "breakdownCategory": "BATTERY_JUMPSTART",
  "technicianAssignedName": "Suresh Gowda (Bay-1 Mechanic)",
  "estimatedArrivalMinutes": 12,
  "requiredToolKit": ["Heavy Duty 12V Jump Starter", "Voltmeter Diagnostics"],
  "safetyPrecautions": [
    "Turn off vehicle ignition and hazard lights",
    "Keep parking bay perimeter clear for technician cart"
  ],
  "estimatedCostInr": 250,
  "coveredUnderSubscription": true,
  "auditTimestamp": "2026-11-21T08:30:00Z"
}";
return [{ json: { prompt: prompt.replace("__DATA__", JSON.stringify(item, null, 2)), originalInput: item } }];
